description: This file defines the vardefs (variable definitions) for the 'Favorites' module in SuiteCRM, including field specifications, relationships, and configuration settings. It also ensures the VardefManager class is loaded and invokes its method to create vardefs for this module.

classes.name: VardefManager
classes.description: A class responsible for handling variable definitions for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: createVardef
methods.description: Creates vardef definitions for a given module, object, and types.
